label: The initial plugin scaffold: 24 files, credential and argument-parsing defects

origin.note: The same two config.mjs defects as config-origin, but buried in 14 code files instead of one. The pair measures whether context dilution costs recall.

defects.description: normalizeBaseUrl discards credentials and the query string when rebuilding from url.origin.
resolveProfile sends a named profile’s API key to whatever host --base-url names.

parseArgs pushes a non-flag token to positionals and continues, so flag recognition never stops at the first word of the request: "explain the --model flag" sends a model named "flag". splitBlob returns at the equivalent point; this path does not.

dropped.claim: Quotes were stripped before the flag test, so a quoted --model was read as a flag.
dropped.reason: Lives inside readToken’s quote handling with no single offending line to anchor on.

dropped.claim: The documented -- terminator was dead: the prompt was re-scanned for flags afterwards.
dropped.reason: The bug is in the caller that re-scans, not in args.mjs, where the terminator branch reads correctly. Attributing it to a line here would be a guess.

dropped.claim: --prompt-file discarded any request text passed beside it.
dropped.reason: Only the hint string mentions --prompt-file in this blob; the discard is not locatable to a line.

dropped.claim: A --max-tokens larger than the window produced a negative budget and blamed the input size.
dropped.reason: Not present at this commit — context-guard.mjs does not read maxTokens here. It was introduced and fixed later (4293726), so scoring it against this case would be false.
